title: Jacobi formula for the derivative of the graph area integrand
statement:
Let n, l be natural numbers and e_a = EuclideanSpace.single a 1 the standard basis of R^n. For P in L(R^n, R^l) let g(P) be the n x n matrix g(P)_{ab} := delta_{ab} +

(the matrix 1 + Matrix.of (fun a b => inner (P e_a) (P e_b))) and J(P) := sqrt(det g(P)) (the area integrand of the graph). Then for every P in L(R^n, R^l), J is Frechet differentiable at P, and for every Psi in L(R^n, R^l), DJ(P)[Psi] = J(P) * sum_{a,c} (g(P)^{-1})_{ac}

, where g(P)^{-1} is the matrix inverse.
lean_statement: ∀ n ℓ : ℕ, ∀ P : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun P' : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ => Real.sqrt (Matrix.det ((1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) + Matrix.of fun a b : Fin n => inner ℝ (P' (EuclideanSpace.single a (1 : ℝ))) (P' (EuclideanSpace.single b (1 : ℝ)))))) P ∧ ∀ Ψ : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, fderiv ℝ (fun P' : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ => Real.sqrt (Matrix.det ((1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) + Matrix.of fun a b : Fin n => inner ℝ (P' (EuclideanSpace.single a (1 : ℝ))) (P' (EuclideanSpace.single b (1 : ℝ)))))) P Ψ = Real.sqrt (Matrix.det ((1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) + Matrix.of fun a b : Fin n => inner ℝ (P (EuclideanSpace.single a (1 : ℝ))) (P (EuclideanSpace.single b (1 : ℝ))))) * ∑ a : Fin n, ∑ c : Fin n, ((1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) + Matrix.of fun a b : Fin n => inner ℝ (P (EuclideanSpace.single a (1 : ℝ))) (P (EuclideanSpace.single b (1 : ℝ))))⁻¹ a c * inner ℝ (P (EuclideanSpace.single c (1 : ℝ))) (Ψ (EuclideanSpace.single a (1 : ℝ)))
